page_title: AUX 0-3 REN | Auxerre v Rennes 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Auxerre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+3' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) receives a cross on the edge of the box and quickly shoots. He sends the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper quickly reacts and makes a good save. Good work from Auxerre as they win a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Brice Samba pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
88' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Mahdi Camara and he is replaced by Henrick Do Marcolino (Rennes).
87' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' Substitution. Tidiane Devernois (Auxerre) has come on for Kevin Danois.
85' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Mahdi Camara (Rennes) for his blatant foul.
83' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
83' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Rennes have a corner.
82' Auxerre produce a short pass from the free kick.
81' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.
78' Here is a change. Arnaud Nordin is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Yassir Zabiri (Rennes).
78' The game has come to an end for Sebastian Szymanski. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Djaoui Cisse (Rennes).
77' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Auxerre, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
76' What was Valentin Rongier (Rennes) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
75' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) commits a rough challenge and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

71' The corner kick from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

71' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the right side of the goal, but Donovan Leon made a superb athletic save to deny him. Rennes earn a corner.

69' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
68' A substitution has been made. Mousa Tamari is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
68' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Breel Embolo (Rennes) replaces Esteban Lepaul.
67' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
65' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
63' Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
62' The resulting set piece from Auxerre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' A lofted cross from Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Auxerre win a corner.
60' Dangerous play by Josue Casimir (Auxerre). Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) was quite harsh and Gael Angoula didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
52' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' A clumsy foul by Josue Casimir (Auxerre) and Gael Angoula blows his whistle.
47' Booking. Quentin Merlin (Rennes) receives a caution from the referee.
46' Half-time substitution. Christophe Pelissier decided to make a change. Sekou Mara is replaced by Gideon Mensah (Auxerre).
46' Half-time substitution. Naouirou Ahamada will not participate anymore and Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is coming on.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Clement Akpa (Auxerre) is replaced by Marvin Senaya.
46' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Fredrik Oppegard comes on the pitch for Lamine Sy (Auxerre).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Gael Angoula blows for a foul after Arnaud Nordin (Rennes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45+3' Rennes keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 3 Goal! Great play by Mousa Tamari releases Mahdi Camara (Rennes) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top right corner. 0:3.
41' The resulting corner from Valentin Rongier (Rennes) is cleared by the defence.

41' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Rennes can continue in their attacking effort.
41' Arnaud Nordin (Rennes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
35' Rough tackle by Naouirou Ahamada (Auxerre). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Auxerre continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
33' Gael Angoula blows his whistle. Valentin Rongier (Rennes) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to Auxerre.
32' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
31' A corner kick by Auxerre is thwarted by the well prepared Brice Samba (Rennes).
29' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
29' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) commits a foul and Gael Angoula immediately signals a free kick.
28' Rennes are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
25' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.

22' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) darts into the box to collect a fantastic lofted pass from Sebastian Szymanski and unleashes a powerful shot directed into the roof of the net. The ball bounces in off the crossbar, increasing the score of today's match. It's now 0:2.
21' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Mahdi Camara (Rennes) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 0:1.
19' The goal by Auxerre is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
18' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Gael Angoula wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
17' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
15' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) brings an opponent down and Gael Angoula interrupts the game.
13' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
9' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
7' Arnaud Nordin (Rennes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gael Angoula blows for a foul.
6' Naouirou Ahamada (Auxerre) sends in a cross from the free kick which goes out of play.
5' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Auxerre have a free kick from a promising distance.
3' The free kick from long range, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) was too forceful with his tackle and Gael Angoula interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rennes will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula will supervise the game today.
